capabilities: Preview articles with built-in or custom CSS themes
Copy styled HTML with inlined CSS for pasting into the WeChat editor
Publish drafts and upload images via the WeChat Official Account API
Manage, create, and edit CSS themes in a dedicated view
Render LaTeX math formulas as PNG images using the CodeCogs API
disambiguation: Not a general blog or website publisher; it targets WeChat Official Accounts specifically.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed. Dual-licensed AGPL-3.0 with commercial licensing available from the author. WeChat API requires IP whitelisting on the WeChat platform, which can break with dynamic IPs. Math rendering needs network access to the CodeCogs API. Installable via BRAT for beta versions.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to format articles for WeChat Official Accounts or push them to a WeChat draft box.

summary: Publishing tool that previews notes with themed CSS styling and publishes them to WeChat Official Accounts via copy-paste or the WeChat API.
